items.title: Ask a Scientist: How are researchers using AI to help pregnant women access ultrasounds?
items.content: By pairing AI with “blind sweep” ultrasounds, Google researchers found a way to get more people the prenatal ultrasounds they need.
items.contentSnippet: By pairing AI with “blind sweep” ultrasounds, Google researchers found a way to get more people the prenatal ultrasounds they need.

summaries.zh: 谷歌研究人员通过将AI技术与“盲扫”超声波结合，发现了一种帮助更多孕妇获得产前超声波检查的方法。该方法提升了超声波图像质量，使资源匮乏地区或医疗条件有限的孕妇也能获得必要的检查。
summaries.en: Google researchers have developed AI technology to enhance "blind sweep" ultrasounds, improving access to prenatal care for more women. The innovation uses AI to analyze ultrasound data, making it easier to obtain necessary prenatal ultrasounds. This approach aims to address shortages in ultrasound services, ensuring better prenatal monitoring for expectant mothers. The technology represents a significant advancement in reproductive healthcare accessibility.

items.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
items.content: Introducing EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model optimized for privacy-first use cases
items.contentSnippet: Introducing EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model optimized for privacy-first use cases

summaries.zh: EmbeddingGemma 2是一款面向隐私优先用例的开源多模态嵌入模型。该模型具有开放性和轻量化特点，适用于隐私保护场景。
summaries.en: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model designed for privacy-first applications. It enables efficient and secure processing of diverse data types while maintaining accessibility. The model is optimized for tasks requiring minimal computational resources, making it suitable for edge devices and low-power environments. Its open nature allows for broader adoption and customization. EmbeddingGemma 2 focuses on balancing performance with privacy, ensuring data integrity without compromising functionality. The model supports integration into various systems where multimodal input is needed.
